title: AUTOMATED ANALYZER
text: The purpose of the present invention is to prevent the outflow and inflow of heat between the outside and inside of a storage chamber when a container is loaded into the storage chamber from outside and thereby prevent degradation resulting from temperature variation in the liquid stored in the storage chamber. Specifically, an automatic analysis device is provided with a storage chamber for adjusting the temperature of and storing a container in which liquid is stored, an opening provided in a portion of the storage chamber, and a loader mechanism for bringing the container in and out of the storage chamber by moving the container through the opening, and is characterized in that the loader mechanism and storage chamber are closed by an elastic body. In the present invention, attaching a sealing member for sealing to an upper part from among overlapping parts makes it difficult for debris and dust to adhere to the sealing member and makes it possible to maintain the sealed state of a reagent storage chamber over a long period of time.

title: POWER STORAGE CONTROL DEVICE, POWER CONVERSION DEVICE, POWER STORAGE SYSTEM, POWER STORAGE CONTROL METHOD, AND PROGRAM
text: An object of the present invention is to provide a power storage control device, power conversion device, power storage system, power storage control method, and program contributing to slowing down deterioration of a storage battery by normally stopping charging and discharging the storage battery when the storage battery is close to depletion, and reducing the frequency of replacing the storage battery. In a power storage control device, power conversion device, power storage system, power storage control method, and program according to the present invention, a power storage control device (2) includes a controller (2a) with control modes including: a first mode in which the storage battery (13) is allowed to be charged and discharged if a remaining capacity of the storage battery (13) is equal to or greater than a threshold value and is prohibited from being charged and discharged if the remaining capacity is less than the threshold value; and a second mode in which the storage battery (13) is allowed to start being charged with electricity if the remaining capacity is less than the threshold value. In a situation where the controller (2a) prohibits the storage battery (13) from being charged and discharged while controlling the operation in the first mode, a mode changer (2b) allows the control mode to be changed into the second mode.

title: APPARATUS AND METHOD FOR OIL EQUALIZATION IN MULTIPLE-COMPRESSOR SYSTEMS
text: A method of operating a refrigeration system, that includes providing a plurality of compressors connected in parallel. The plurality of compressors includes a plurality of scroll compressors. Recovery of monomers from reciprocating compressors

Description

Packing losses at multistage compressors, used in high pressure polyethylene plants, are contained through collection and recycling to the low pressure suction stage. Monomers being emitted at the low pressure compressor are collected and sent to a thermal oxidiser or to a flaring system.

Minimisation of VOC emissions from compressors.

reduction of energy consumption by using regenerative techniques
flaring leads to an increase of CO2 emissions.

title: METHOD OF COORDINATING OPERATION OF COMPRESSORS
text: A method for coordinating operation between at least two groups of compressors in a cooling circuit is disclosed. A first group of compressors forms part of a low temperature (LT) part of the cooling circuit and a second group of compressors forms part of a high temperature (MT) part of the cooling circuit. Each of the compressor groups comprises one or more compressors, and each of the compressor groups comprises a controller, the controllers being capable of exchanging signals.In the case that the LT compressor group needs one or more of the LT compressors to start operation, it is investigated whether or not one or more of the MT compressors is/are operating. If this is the case, one or more of the LT compressors is/are allowed to start operation. If it is not the case, the suction pressure in the MT part of the cooling circuit is established, e.g. measured, and compared to a lower and an upper limit of a neutral pressure zone, said neutral pressure zone lying within an operating pressure zone of the MT part of the cooling circuit. Finally, the MT compressors and the LT compressors are operated based on the comparing step.The cooling system may be a cascade system or a booster system.

title: LOAD BALANCING METHOD FOR TWO COMPRESSORS
text: A load balancing method for two compressors. The two compressors are used in a refrigeration system and are driven coaxially by the same driving device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining parameters, determining balance, and controlling start/stop states. The parameters in the step of obtaining parameters are parameters related to the two compressors, such as a compressor suction side flow rate, or exhaust side flow rate, or suction side temperature; the step of determining balance comprises determining, on the basis of the obtained parameters related to the two compressors, whether load is balanced between the two compressors; the step of controlling start/top states comprises controlling the start/stop states of the two compressors according to whether the load is balanced. The method can monitor the load balance state of two compressors that are coaxially driven, thereby effectively avoiding failure of the refrigeration system caused by unbalanced loads of the compressors.

title: METHOD FOR REDUCING THE PULSATION LEVEL IN A MULTI-COMPRESSOR PLANT EMPLOYING RECIPROCATING COMPRESSORS
text: Method for reducing the pulsation level in a multi-compressor plant comprising a plurality of reciprocating compressors (100) connected in parallel to a gas piping system, wherein each compressor (100) is driven by a respective motor (110); the method comprising the following steps: (step 1) assessing a number of compressors running in parallel; (step 2) determining the worst pressure pulsation sum with a single compressor running, by the determination of the worst operating conditions; (step 3) determining the worst pressure pulsation sum with a plurality of compressors running in parallel, by the determination of the worst operating conditions imposing 0° phase among compressors; (step 4) determining the best pressure pulsation sum imposing a different phase among compressors starting from a phase that is equal to 360°/N c, wherein N c is the maximum number of compressors in operation; (step 5) determining the best phase shift among compressors when the pressure pulsations peaks generated by each compressor is distributed as to avoid superimposition under the condition that, for each capacity control case, the resulting main frequency of combination is the highest possible; (step 6) starting a first motor of a first reciprocating compressor; and (step 7) starting in succession each other motors in order to synchronize all motors between each other with the determined phase shift.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR OPTIMIZING OPERATIONAL CONTROL OF COMPRESSORS IN MULTI-COUPLE UNIT AIR-CONDITIONING SYSTEM
text: Disclosed is a method and a device for optimizing the operational control of compressors in a multi-couple unit air-conditioning system. The method comprises: acquiring rated output amount information and rated power consumption amount information of each of the compressors in the multi-couple unit air-conditioning system; acquiring a required output amount demand threshold value; and selecting the compressors and operating frequencies thereof, so that the total of the rated output amounts of the selected compressors is not less than the output amount demand threshold value and the total of the rated power consumption amounts of the selected compressors is the minimum, thus the actual operational energy efficiency ratio of the multi-couple unit air-conditioning system can be improved.
